prompt:
A continuous FOUR-SECOND portrait shot in an exquisite handmade paper departure workshop. Begin exactly at the supplied EMPTY first frame and finish exactly at the supplied settled last frame. Travi, the tall coral ribbed spinner luggage mascot, ROLLS INTO VIEW FROM OUTSIDE THE LEFT EDGE and stops at his marked position on the middle-right. This is a physical wheeled entrance, never a fade, growth, teleportation or materialisation.

0–0.2 seconds: show the empty stage.
0.2–1.7 seconds: Travi rolls briskly in from off-screen LEFT along the foreground cream floor, IN FRONT OF the stationary folio and tickets. His four caster wheels visibly rotate, stay grounded, and carry his body across the screen. He is the same full-size character from the final reference from the moment he appears, not a tiny case growing bigger. He leans slightly with momentum, folded paper arms balance him, luggage tag trails lightly. His eyes are open and bright, brows lifted, smile eager.
1.7–2.4 seconds: brake at the final middle-right mark with one tiny overshoot and a controlled two-degree rock back. A fleeting surprised eyebrow lift as if he arrived a little too keenly, immediately becoming a pleased grin. No jumping or airborne wheels.
2.4–3.3 seconds: straighten and give a small friendly folded-paper hand greeting, like an enthusiastic capable porter saying hello. His bright eyes turn towards the traveller. Retain the reference's normal eye size, delighted open smile and warm personality.
3.3–4 seconds: ease into the EXACT final-frame body placement, scale, hand pose, face, handles and grounded wheels. Hold that settled reference pose for the last half-second so the next idle animation can begin without a jump.

IDENTITY: only the supplied modern CORAL upright hard-shell ribbed spinner. Tall rounded rectangular silhouette, sculpted VERTICAL ribs, navy clamshell zipper band, four dark realistic swivel caster assemblies, brass twin telescopic rails with navy pull grip, separate short grab handle, cream tag with tiny navy palm, exactly two folded-paper arms. Case stays closed. Preserve tactile paper grain, original face shape and sophisticated adult-friendly craft style.

LOCK THE CAMERA AND SET: fixed camera, identical framing and warm lighting, motionless petrol-teal paper wall and curved paper-theatre wings, cream stage floor, stationary closed teal folio and two blank cream tickets at lower left. Respect the large empty upper heading zone and lower control zone. Keep Travi's entire body and handles inside the settled stage area, away from these safe zones.

Controlled physical paper-puppet movement with an accurate moving floor shadow. No cuts, zoom, camera drift, destination scenery, unfolding world, glossy plastic, enormous eyes, sleepy half-lids, prolonged blink, frantic bouncing, extra limbs, changing luggage shape, moving background props, text, logos, subtitles, UI or sound. Silent.
idea: Travary intro — coral spinner Travi rolls in, brakes a little too keenly and warmly greets the traveller
